author: ioioy
body:
ioioy's Mixtapes

So, I've decided since I'm at boarding school, to make mix-tapes, most likely as a hobby, which isn't to do with school. I've done this, since I've been wanting to this ever since I've had interest in music, especially electronic music. Hence why most of these mixes will be EDM-based mixes.

I hope you appreciate the time and effort it takes to create these mixes, through the creation, editing, rendering and uploading, and I'm doing this for no-profit, so most of my mixes will have copyright claims, so please leave like, and as I will be doing mixes often, I highly suggest subscribing.

As well as this, please comment either on the video or here on how I can make the mixes better quality, and how to improve overall, it would really help me out. You can also suggest genres or artists to do mixes of in the future!

Here are the List of my Mix's so far:

Multi Genre Mix

Chill Mix

Monstercat Trap 2014-2015 Mix
